# Danny Okafor — Department Lead, Footwear

- **Relationship:** department lead reporting to Marc; owns the **footwear** zone — the store's highest-margin,
  highest-shrink category.
- **Cadence:** touch-base at the morning huddle; no formal 1:1, though Marc's considering starting one.
- **Owns:** footwear planograms and the vendor relationship with [Chris Donovan](../people/chris-donovan.md)
  of TrailTech; runs the footwear endcap resets (see [Endcap Reset — Summer](../projects/endcap-reset-summer.md)).
- **Strengths:** deep product knowledge, associates respect him, customers ask for him by name. A strong
  internal candidate for the open Assistant Manager role [Kyle Bennett](../people/kyle-bennett.md) vacated —
  Marc is quietly assessing whether to encourage him to apply.
- **Watch-outs:** never managed people formally; would need coaching on scheduling and accountability if promoted.
